title: How this portfolio tailors itself
introduction: One job posting becomes a tailored pack and a portfolio link. Two acts show how it is prepared and how it is served.

tailor.introduction: The server-side pipeline turns a posting into a tailored portfolio, resume and cover letter. The stages below distinguish model work from deterministic steps.

stages.name: Ingest
stages.description: Fetches the job posting from a URL or pasted text.

stages.name: Signals
stages.description: Resolves company and role from the posting.

stages.name: Liveness
stages.description: Checks the posting is still open.

stages.name: Fit
stages.description: Scores the posting against the candidate profile on a 1–5 scale.

stages.name: Bake
stages.description: Builds a tailored portfolio through discovery, layout planning and composition; mints and stores a short id.

stages.name: Links
stages.description: Builds the portfolio link with ?j=<short id>. A failed bake still yields a record without a link.

stages.name: Resume
stages.description: Tailors the resume to the posting from the candidate's CV facts only.

stages.name: Cover
stages.description: Tailors a cover letter. Omits the portfolio link rather than inventing one.

qualityGates: CV fact gate — every claim must exist in the CV.
Exactly one page with at least 95% fill.
tailor.humanReview: A human always reviews and submits. Nothing is applied automatically.

recordedRun.resume: 1 page · 99.2% fill · fact gate passed · reverse-chronological roles
recordedRun.cover: Includes an honest gaps paragraph — no production federated GraphQL router or API metering yet.
recordedRun.curationLabel: Tailored for an API platform role
recordedRun.previewDescription: A ?j= link loads a stored layout, with no LLM at view time. Highlighted specimens stay bright; the rest dim. Any failure falls back to the baked snapshot.

serve.introduction: The same tailored link, or an Ask request, follows this path. Only service roles are shown.

hops.description: The visitor opens the portfolio link or asks a question.
Serves the static portfolio site to the browser.
The edge proxy holds the API key as an encrypted secret and injects it. The browser never sees a key.
Forwards the request to the home server.
Serves stored layouts and routes model work when needed.
Model work runs on dual RTX 3060 via the LiteLLM gateway, or on Claude.

serve.response: The response returns the same way, back to the browser.
serve.fallback: Any hop down → baked snapshot. The portfolio remains readable when the backend is offline.
